prose: Simon Willison quotes Anthropic's Frontier Red Team evaluation of GLM-5.3: on 100 tasks from an internal Binary Exploitation benchmark, GLM-5.3 achieved full control-flow hijacks in 4% of trials versus 6% for Claude Mythos Preview. The significance, per the quote, is that a threshold has been crossed - earlier models such as Claude Opus 4.6 and GLM-5.2 succeeded in none of the trials.
highlights: GLM-5.3: full control-flow hijacks in 4% of 100 binary-exploitation trials
Claude Mythos Preview: 6% on the same benchmark
Earlier models (Claude Opus 4.6, GLM-5.2): zero successes
Anthropic frames this as a meaningful threshold crossed in autonomous exploitation
Quotation collected by Simon Willison, 29 Sep 2026
